Runs 6–7 (ana) put the device in the QH regime from ~2 T with Rxx minima at ≈ 0 Ω, but the two 1D cuts share a dominant **7.1–7.4 T tone that does not scale with n** (2.7× density change) alongside n-dependent content — a two-band (ABAB-type light band) reading and an ungated-region reading are indistinguishable in 1D. The fan separates them: gated bands fan out of the CNP, an ungated region is a horizontal stripe. It also (i) fixes the **absolute density scale** from the LL slopes ν = nh/eB (c_tg is still the 9.5 nm prior), (ii) reads the degeneracy sequence out of the CNP (±4 vs ±8), (iii) shows crossings (two bands) vs a single fan, (iv) e/h asymmetry. **Design:** fast axis = (V_tg, V_bg) co-swept along the run-5-calibrated D = 0 line, n = −1.25 → +3.25×10¹² in 131 pts (Δn 0.035×10¹² ≈ 9.9 mV TG; ≥ 5.6 pts per 4-fold gap above 2 T, 28 at 10 T); slow = B 0.4 → 10 T in 0.2 T, 49 rows, uniform in B so LL lines are straight. **Coverage trade:** the hole side stops at −1.25×10¹² (TG −0.3 V limit) vs +3.25 on the electron side — the D = 0 line is TG-limited at both ends, nothing more is reachable without leaving D = 0; the B range starts at 0.4 T (below ~1.5 T there are no oscillations at this T_e). from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_vec = np.linspace(-1.25, 3.25, 131)            # 1e12 cm^-2, dn = 0.035e12 (~10 mV TG); TG-limited both ends
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = calc_gate_voltages(n_vec, 0.0, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
Vtg_vec, Vbg_vec = np.asarray(Vtg_vec), np.asarray(Vbg_vec)

assert Vbg_vec.min() >= BG_MIN + MARGIN and Vbg_vec.max() <= BG_MAX - MARGIN, (Vbg_vec.min(), Vbg_vec.max())
